name: Lichess user API
tier_rationale: Free/libre community project run by a non-profit association with public API documentation and terms and a long public track record (A8 community); P116 FC9 records Lichess as community.

reliability.justification: The platform's own answer is authoritative for the existence and public fields of its accounts; profile fields (names, links, bios) are self-declared by the owner.

user_api.title: Lichess user API (lichess.org/api/user/{username})

terms.quote: P116 FC4 (binding council text): documented public APIs (Chess.com PubAPI, Lichess, Mojang, Steam Community XML, Medium RSS, Pinterest widget, Stack Exchange API, Twitch Helix with the team's app) are 'open' once recorded; Snapchat __NEXT_DATA__ and the Disqus profile page are 'unknown' and stay disabled in every profile until legal records them (A1).

user_api.notes: Research C0269: 404 {'error': 'Not found'} = ABSENT. One request at a time; after a 429 no Lichess request for 60 s (documented; P116 FC5): retries 0 so the core never retries a 429 in-run, the module keeps a 60 s cooldown in its state. profile.links (free text) are linked accounts (expand=False).
